comments.label: E-002 · visual block
comments.text: The pop up polyhedron should always go in the bottom left corner of the mini preview area. I think it's not at that bottom corner right now (it's a little high), because the episode description is maybe longer than the code expected. Shorter episode descriptions (like E-001's) might have some negative space below them, because there's some sort of minimum mini preview height. Longer ones (like E-001's) sets the mini preview height.
